review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294518, the native FPI Controller Pool is an active minter and its owner is the 3-of-5 Frax Comptroller Safe, with no enabled modules and a zero guard. Frax's FPI overview and Controller Pool documentation describe native issuance and redemption against FRAX collateral through the 100% collateral-ratio AMO path. The FPI token's owner-controlled minter set is a separate canonical control that can authorize native minters. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: canonical native issuance is collateral-bounded, so the authored posture is bounded-admin and economicCapSemantics is bounded; no adapter or destination mint is used to justify these values. Reconciliation remains unknown because the Frax collateral feed is composition-only and does not provide a whole-supply liability reconciliation for the native Controller Pool path. No independent attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced.
